description: A partition index on an AWS Glue Data Catalog table, made with CreatePartitionIndex. AWS has no call that changes an index, so every property is create-only. Glue builds one index on a table at a time.

PartitionIndex.description: The index: its name and the partition keys it indexes, in order.

IndexName.description: The name of the partition index.

Keys.description: The partition keys of the table the index covers, in the order the index concatenates them.

CatalogId.description: The ID of the Data Catalog the table is in, such as the AWS account ID.

DatabaseName.description: The name of the database the table is in. AWS Glue stores it in lowercase.

TableName.description: The name of the table to index. AWS Glue stores it in lowercase.

IndexStatus.description: The status of the index: CREATING, ACTIVE, or DELETING. AWS keeps an index it failed to build in the table's history as FAILED, where it can't be deleted, and Radius creates the index again on the next deploy.
